Physical_Environment.Location: Tsinghua University, Beijing, China (ethics approval THU-04-2025-1135; participants recruited from the local community)

Equipment.Software: PsychoPy 2022.2.4 (standalone PsychoPy experiment; psychopyVersion = 2022.2.4 recorded in every raw data file)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 3 (identity: true self, general self, stranger) x 2 (trial type: matching, nonmatching), within-subjects; 60 trials per condition (shape identity x trial type)

Block_Structure.Block_number: 6 blocks (60 trials each; a self-paced rest screen followed trials 60, 120, 180, 240 and 300)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 360 trials total per participant (60 per condition; randomized order across the 6 blocks); all 360 trials are retained in the database, including no-response and RT < 200 ms trials
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: one criterion practice block with feedback, repeated until six consecutive correct responses (programme variable practice_times = 6); length varies between participants (6-224 trials, median 23; 1,788 practice trials in total across the 48 participants). Practice trials are flagged in the Clean file (Phase = practice) and were excluded from the authors' analyses.

Trial_Structure.Fixation_duration: 500 ms (fixation cross on grey background; the cross remains on screen while the shape-label pair is displayed, 600 ms in total)
Trial_Structure.SOA: 0 ms (shape and label presented simultaneously; shape above, label below, 3.5 deg apart)
Trial_Structure.ISI: 0 ms (simultaneous presentation of shape and label)
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 1100 ms (blank screen from stimulus offset; only the keys z and m were accepted, 'reaction too slow' feedback otherwise)
Trial_Structure.ITI: not reported separately (the next trial starts with the 500 ms fixation cross)
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 500 ms (feedback text in Chinese: 反应正确 correct / 反应错误 incorrect / 反应过慢 too slow)

Stimulus_Properties.Fixation: white fixation cross (+) on grey background (RGB 127, 127, 127), 500 ms
Stimulus_Properties.Shape: geometric shape images presented above the fixation cross: circle.png, rectangle.png (the file renders a white square of 214 x 213 px on a 300 x 300 px canvas, i.e. the 'square' of the article) and triangle.png; displayed at 2.4 deg x 2.4 deg. The shape-identity binding was counterbalanced across participants (conditions 1-6: 1 = circle-true self/square-general self/triangle-stranger, 2 = circle-true self/triangle-general self/square-stranger, ... 6) and is recorded per trial in the Clean file (Shape, Shape_Origin_Identity)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: Chinese identity words presented below the fixation cross at approx. 4.4 deg x 2.4 deg: 真实我 (true self), 一般我 (general self), 陌生人 (stranger)

Colors.Stimulus: white shapes and white text on grey background

exp1.detail: Experiment 1 of Zhao & Wang (2026, Psychon Bull Rev, DOI 10.3758/s13423-026-03000-8). Shape-label matching (Sui et al., 2012): participants first had the true self and the general self defined in Chinese, then learned the mapping between three geometric shapes and the labels 真实我 (true self), 一般我 (general self) and 陌生人 (stranger), and finally judged whether presented shape-label pairs matched the learned mapping. The matching key was counterbalanced (conditions A: match = z, non-match = m; B: match = m, non-match = z) together with the shape-identity binding, giving 12 counterbalance conditions assigned randomly by the programme (author variable group 1-12; retained in the Clean file as Counterbalance and in the raw file as condition/group). DATA SOURCE AND REBUILD (2026-10-13): the standard files were rebuilt from the authors' original per-participant PsychoPy data files (Zhao_2026_PsychonBullRev_Raw/EXP1-true self spe/programming_files/data/*.csv, 48 files), which record every trial with its shape image, Chinese label word, identity codes, block/trial position and raw response. The earlier version of these files was derived from the authors' filtered OSF analysis file (osf.io/j2pxc, data/hddm_trial_data/exp1_hddm_trial_data.xlsx, 15,659 rows) and therefore lacked no-response and RT < 200 ms trials, the 3 excluded participants, block/trial numbering, shape geometry and label words; that OSF file is retained in the input zone and is reproduced exactly by the rebuilt Clean file when the authors' filters are applied (rows with a response and RT >= 200 ms, analysed participants only; verified as an exact trial-by-trial match on match / shape_identity / response / corr / rt / subj_idx). All participants with data are kept in the database (48; Sample_Size = 48): the authors excluded participants 7, 46 and 48 for below-chance overall accuracy and analysed 45 (33 female; Mage 22.84, SD 2.15), so Valid_Subj = 45 and Drop_Subj = 3 in Dataset_inf.csv; the OSF analysis file does not contain those three participants. ACC is coded per database convention (1 = correct key, 0 = incorrect key, NA = no response; PsychoPy records corr = 0 for no-response trials, which are recoded to NA here); Response and CorrResponse hold the physical keys (z / m) recorded in the original data. Label identity is available for every trial, including nonmatching trials (the label word presented is part of the original trial log). CAVEAT: because true self and general self both map onto the standardized category Self, Matching cannot be recovered from Shape_Standardized_Identity vs Label_Standardized_Identity in this experiment (16.7% of rows would look inconsistent); compare Shape_English_Identity with Label_English_Identity instead. The matching-trials-only analyses reported in the article used the authors' own filtering (practice trials, no-response trials and RT < 200 ms trials removed). OPEN POINT: the practice sequence of 17 of the 48 sessions (all collected before 2025-03-31) does not end with six consecutive correct responses and therefore does not match the stopping rule implemented in the archived programme version (SPE.psyexp, modified 2025-03-31); practice lengths in those sessions range from 6 to 73 trials. Practice trials were excluded from all reported analyses, so this does not affect the published results; the exact earlier programme version was not provided and the difference is recorded here as unresolved. Questionnaires after the task (online): BTS, SCS, SEB (per-participant scores in the OSF behaviour file, not part of the trial-level database). Ethics: Tsinghua University Ethics Committee THU-04-2025-1135.
